name: VenusBlood Savior
source:
The continent of Levancia, where humanity enjoys prosperity under the blessing of Harial, the goddess of the sun.  The goddess of darkness, Ishtar, was sealed, and the dark demons were squeezed into the frontiers and the bottom of the earth.

Because of the era full of light, the demons seek a savior.
An old demon king who once followed Ishtar.  His resurrection was the long-cherished wish of the demons.

Time has passed and the Demon King finally makes his resurrection.
Regius, the hero of the demons. And confronting him are the heroes of the sacred treasures of this world.

"Now is the time to create a demon paradise ──!"

The battle to bring about change in the age of light and darkness is about to begin.
translation:
雷万西亚大陆上，人类在太阳女神哈利艾露的庇佑下，享受着繁荣。黑暗女神伊修塔尔遭到封印，黑暗中的魔族被挤压到了边境与地底。

在这个光明鼎盛的时代，魔族渴求着救世主。
曾经追随伊修塔尔的古老魔王，让他复活，便是魔族长久以来的夙愿。

时光流转，魔王终于复苏。
他就是魔族的英雄，雷吉乌斯。与他对峙的是这个世界中持有神器的勇者们。

“现在，正是建立魔族乐园之时——！”

为光明与黑暗的时代带来变革的战斗即将开始。
